propositions: On the agentic execution path, accumulated tool-result message history is re-sent uncached every turn, causing O(N^2) input token cost growth that is invisible to telemetry because the system breakpoint alone registers cache hits.

The cache_settings_for function sets only two of four available cache breakpoints (anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions) and explicitly does not set anthropic_cache_messages or anthropic_cache on Anthropic, or bedrock_cache_messages on Bedrock.

For multi-turn agentic runs, the Anthropic and Bedrock providers require different cache configuration keys: Anthropic needs anthropic_cache=True for automatic message tail caching, while Bedrock needs bedrock_cache_messages=True (not a top-level cache_control key, which Bedrock rejects).

Single-turn paths must remain byte-identical after the fix to avoid regression, and multi-turn cache effectiveness must be measurable through per-call cache_read_tokens growth attributable to message history rather than static system blocks.
